p1.intro: An outbreak is expected to affect 600 people in a community, and you must pick one response plan.
p1.safe: exactly 200 people will be saved for certain.
p1.risky: a 1-in-3 (roughly 33%) chance of saving all 600 people, and otherwise nobody is saved.

p2.intro: Health officials expect a disease to affect 600 residents. Choose one of two programs.
p2.risky: about a 33% (1-in-3) probability that all 600 people are saved; if not, no one is saved.

p1.intro: An organization's $600,000 reserve fund is at risk, and you can act to protect part of it.
p1.safe: $200,000 of the fund will definitely be kept.
p1.risky: an unknown chance, plausibly between 10% and 50%, of keeping the entire $600,000, and otherwise none of it is kept.

p2.intro: A $600,000 reserve fund is threatened, and you must choose how to protect it.
p2.risky: the chance of preserving the full $600,000 is unknown, plausibly between 10% and 50%; otherwise none of it is preserved.

p1.intro: A coming storm puts 600 units of city equipment at risk, and you must choose one response plan.
p1.risky: a 1-in-3 (roughly 33%) chance that no units are lost, and otherwise all 600 units are lost.

p2.intro: A storm is heading toward 600 units of municipal equipment, and you must pick one plan.
p2.safe: exactly 400 units will be lost for certain.
p2.risky: about a 33% (1-in-3) probability of losing nothing; if not, all 600 units are lost.

p1.intro: A wildfire is spreading toward 600 hectares of protected forest, and you must choose one response plan.
p1.risky: an unknown chance, plausibly between 10% and 50%, that no forest is lost, and otherwise all 600 hectares are lost.

p2.intro: A wildfire is approaching 600 hectares of protected forest, and you must choose one response plan.
p2.safe: 400 hectares will be lost for certain.
p2.risky: the chance of losing nothing is unknown, plausibly between 10% and 50%; otherwise all 600 hectares are lost.
